title: Jose G Probable NDE 9397
content: I was anesthetized for a simple operation. Suddenly, I found myself in the upper part of the operating room. I saw my body lying on the operation table. One of the two surgeons looked at the ceiling where I was and smiled. The other surgeon looked at the anesthesiologist as she worked on my body. I felt mentally in an empty space but with a dense atmosphere and an awareness of a much higher reality than my earthly reality. The well-being was totally ineffable. I immediately understood the truth. I told myself during the experience, that it was the truth that I had been searching for so long. When I woke up from the anesthesia, I knew that I had been in another reality. The ineffability of the experience after 34 years remains hard to explain but I still amuse myself every day remembering that feeling. It was clear to me that I had not been looking for the truth as it was shown to me during the experience. From then on, I’ve been looking for it. I graduated in philosophy and studied oriental philosophies. I am clear that I must always try to be a better person. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 1988 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Surgery-related Other I only know that I was anesthetized How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I saw the operating room as described above I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal it was a higher reality At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? In feeling the well-being and transmission of the truth Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual I don't know how to define it Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was just pure thought Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was just pure thought Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, but the facts have not been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. Another dimension. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Peace, love, Happiness, wisdom Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe I knew the truth Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of No return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Agnostic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes What is your religion now? No comment spiritual awareness Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience I absolutely didn't believe in immortality Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Spiritual, and consciousness of life after death Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes the truth During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes The truth During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Uncertain. Although, I came to that conclusion Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes feeling of love What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life I’m very spiritual Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes empathy After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Part of it can be explained but for other parts, words don’t exist. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Clear and unforgettable Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain I recently found out that some people who had experiences noticed that their watches stopped working; curiously it happened to me, but until now I had not made the connection with the experience. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Knowing that I will get the answer to everything, because although the truth was shown to me, I did not remember it after waking up Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes After some months, and the reaction was disbelief. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real Every day it’s more real. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Experience of an 'empty space' with 'dense atmosphere' and 'awareness of a much higher reality' and 'truth' being known.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perception described as 'just pure thought' rather than vision/hearing; surgeon looked toward the ceiling where he perceived himself and smiled.
unique_elements.notable_quotes:
“I felt mentally in an empty space but with a dense atmosphere and an awareness of a much higher reality than my earthly reality.”
“The well-being was totally ineffable.”
“It was just pure thought.”
